primitives.name: Claim Downgrade Machine
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is a downgrade machine: a claim either has evidence, is partially proven, is unsupported, is false, is blocked, needs legal review, or needs owner decision.
primitives.assumptions: Claims evolve deterministically through a finite state space \mathcal{L}. Each state transition depends on evidence accumulation and external validation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \mathbb{P}(\text{evidence}) < \epsilon \), claim enters unsupported or false regime.

layer2.mapping: The downgrade machine \( \mathcal{D}: \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{L} \) mirrors Bayesian updating in GSI's probabilistic logic engine.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of claim state transitions across \( \mathcal{L} \) as proxy for epistemic entropy.

primitives.name: Proven Status Inventory
primitives.verbatim_quote: Current status counts: - Proven: source registry mapping, AWS gate default-off behavior, calibration surfaces, drift primitives, active-learning ranking, GitHub navigation.
primitives.assumptions: Proven claims are those with verified causal pathways; they form a subset \( \mathcal{P} \subset \mathcal{C} \).
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \mathbb{E}[\text{drift}] > \delta \), \( \mathcal{P} \) degrades into partial or unsupported.

layer2.mapping: Kernel \( K(p, r, a) \) encodes the joint likelihood of provenness under registry alignment and active learning.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of \( \mathcal{P} \) against \( \mathcal{L} \) as measured by cross-validation.

primitives.name: Unsupported or False Claims
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Unsupported or false: historical `legal cleared`, `.5+ gain`, `superior edge`, `parity+`, AWS-live, AWS-labeling-live, broad readiness language, and complete competitive-edge claims.
primitives.assumptions: These claims lack sufficient evidence or contradict known facts; \( u \cup f \subset \mathcal{C} \setminus \mathcal{P} \).

layer2.mapping: Kernel \( K(u, f) \) models the entropy of contradiction in historical claims.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of \( |u \cup f| / |\mathcal{C}| \) as indicator of epistemic drift.

primitives.name: Blocked Claims
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Blocked: MC Dropout implementation until an ML runtime is approved.
primitives.assumptions: Claims are blocked when dependencies (e.g., runtime) are unmet; \( b \subset \mathcal{C} \setminus \mathcal{P} \).
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( m = \text{false} \), \( b \) grows linearly with pending dependencies.

layer2.mapping: Kernel \( K(b, m) \) captures conditional probability of blockage given runtime readiness.
layer2.telemetry: Time-to-unblock for \( b \) vs. \( m \) availability log.
